title: Prescriptions Terms: Fill History Amount on Declined Non-Controlled Balances
content:
Patients who fill a Kestrel Prescriptions record in the Non-Controlled Acute Prescription, Non-Controlled Maintenance Prescription or Specialty Limited-Distribution Prescription class regularly receive a non-controlled tenure amount when they decline an owed balance on it.

## Terms

The non-controlled tenure amount counts the original fills and refills dispensed on the prescription in the last 12 months:

| Original fills and refills dispensed in the last 12 months | Tenure amount |
|---|---|
| four or more | 0.25 |
| two or three | 0.10 |
| fewer than two | nothing |

The tenure amount is added to the non-controlled decline credit.

## Examples (hypothetical)

- An original fill and three refills in the last 12 months: four, so 0.25 is added.
- An original fill and one refill: two, so 0.10 is added.
- A single refill: fewer than two, so nothing is added.

**What is counted?** Original fills and refills dispensed on that prescription; balance completions, emergency supplies and corrected remakes are not original fills or refills.
